preconditions.description: The number of elements in the sequence must be between 4 and 100,000.
Each element in the sequence must be an integer within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000.
The total number of elements across all test cases must not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.expression: all(b_i - b_{i-1} == d for i in range(2, N+1))
postconditions.description: The output sequence must be an arithmetic sequence with a common difference d.

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(a_i - b_i) for i in range(N)) <= 1
postconditions.description: The output sequence must differ from the input sequence in at most one position.
